title: Bitcoin ETFs sold through 7 of 8 crashes even as Wall Street makes BTC selloffs less violent
summary: Bitcoin ETFs recorded outflows during seven of eight major selloffs, challenging expectations that Wall Street investors would support prices during downturns.
